blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large aerial platforms often operate above 1.5 km to improve the efficiency of open water search and rescue (OW-SAR). However, long imaging distances, wide fields of view, and limited sensor resolution reduce objects to a few pixels, increasing their susceptibility to environmental interference and making detection harder than for conventional small objects. To our knowledge, existing datasets focus on low-altitude scenarios and do not support automatic detection at 1.5-2.0 km. We therefore present TinyWOD, a tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude OW-SAR using lifebuoys as detection targets. It comprises 11,359 manually annotated images and 19,505 annotated instances spanning diverse environments, lighting conditions, water colors, and surface ripples. Compared with existing datasets, TinyWOD contains much smaller objects and a substantially higher proportion of tiny instances; its average equivalent side length (ESL) is 12.7 pixels, with 76.96% of in stances having ESLs below 15 pixels, reflecting actual high-altitude water-rescue imaging conditions. We define APtiny, a tiny object detection metric, and benchmark mainstream and state-of-the-art networks using this and conventional metrics. All evaluated networks effectively detect tiny waterborne objects, demonstrating TinyWOD's reusability and utility. We expect this dataset to support research on tiny object detection in high-altitude OW-SAR.
blocks.zh: 大型航空平台经常运行于1.5公里以上,以提高开放取水搜救(OW-SAR)的效率. 然而,相距长的成像距离,视野宽广,传感器分辨率有限等效物会将物体降低到几像素,使其更容易受到环境干扰,使探测比常规小物体更难. 据我们所知,现有的数据集侧重于低海拔情景,不支持1.5-2.0公里的自动检测。 因此,我们提出TinyWOD,这是一个用于高空OW-SAR以活体为探测目标的小型物体探测数据集。 它包括11 359个人工说明图像和19 505个附加说明的例子,涉及不同的环境、照明条件、水的颜色和地表波纹。 相较于现有的数据集,TinyWOD包含更小的物体和相当高比例的小例;其平均等效侧长(ESL)为12.7像素,有76.96%的姿势有ESL低于15像素,反映了实际的高空取水成像条件. 我们定义了APtiny, 一个微小的物体检测指标, 以及基准主流 和最先进的网络 使用这个和传统的指标。 所有被评价的网络都有效检测出微小的水上物体,显示出了TinyWOD的可重复性和实用性. 我们期望这个数据集能支持高空OW-SAR中微小天体探测的研究.

blocks.en: Background & Summary
blocks.zh: 背景摘要( T)

blocks.en: The timely detection and accurate localization of targets are essential for OW-SAR [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . For greater SAR efficiency, fixed-wing aircraft can be operated at altitudes of approximately 1.5–2.0 km [ 4 , 5 ] . However, targets observed at such altitudes typically span only 3–15 pixels [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] and waves, reflections, and lighting conditions also affect the imaging characteristics of the water surface. Together, these factors make tiny object detection in high-altitude imagery challenging [ 1 , 8 , 11 ] . To mitigate these difficulties, a range of techniques have been proposed, including multi-scale feature fusion [ 12 , 13 ] , high-resolution inference through image slicing or sparse queries [ 15 , 14 ] , tiny object oriented label assignment and augmentation [ 16 , 10 ] , and dedicated tiny object benchmarks and detectors [ 44 , 43 , 45 ] .
blocks.zh: 对OW-SAR[1、2、3]目标进行及时探测和准确定位至关重要。 为了提高搜索和救援效率,固定翼飞机可以在大约1.5-2.0公里[4,5]的高度上运行。 然而,在这种高度观测到的目标通常只有3至15像素[6、7、8]和波浪、反射和照明条件也影响到水面的成像特征。 这些因素加在一起,使得高海拔图像中的微小物体探测具有挑战性[1,8,11]. 为缓解这些困难,提出了一系列技术,包括多尺度特性聚变[12,13],通过图像切片或稀疏查询进行高分辨率推论[15,14],微小面向对象的标签分配和增强[16,10],以及专用的微小物体基准和探测器[44,43,45].

blocks.en: Many overwater datasets have been developed and used for training, validating, and testing object detection algorithms [ 21 , 42 , 46 ] . The Airbus Ship Detection dataset [ 22 ] is one of the earliest large-scale datasets and contains satellite images with pixel-level ship annotations [ 47 ] . AFO [ 17 ] subsequently provides UAV images for detecting persons and other objects floating on open-water. SeaDronesSee [ 18 ] is a large-scale maritime dataset for object detection and tracking under different flight altitudes, viewing angles, and sea conditions. MOBDrone [ 19 ] supports man-overboard detection and contains UAV videos captured under different altitudes, camera angles, and illumination conditions. SeaPerson [ 20 ] supports tiny-person detection in seaside UAV images and contains both point and bounding-box annotations. Person-in-Water [ 9 ] contains UAV videos recorded over lakes and the sea from different altitudes and viewing angles. IWHR [ 8 ] focuses on floating-debris detection in inland waters using images captured by shore-based cameras and mobile devices. More recently, SearchWing [ 6 ] provides images for high-altitude maritime observation captured at altitudes of up to 750 m; however, the number of images containing annotated vessels is relatively limited, and the dataset is closed-source. Overall, existing overwater datasets are mainly designed for low-altitude object detection and are not well suited to high-altitude OW-SAR scenarios for two reasons. First, their target scales do not match those in high-altitude images: targets in commonly used datasets typically span 20–50 pixels, whereas targets observed at high altitudes span only 3–15 pixels. Second, most images represent relatively calm water conditions or high target-to-background contrast, making it difficult to represent the complex imaging conditions encountered in real-world high-altitude observations.
blocks.zh: 许多过水数据集已经开发出来并用于培训,验证,以及测试物体检测算法[21,42,46]. 空中客车飞船探测数据集[22]是最早的大型数据集之一,包含带有像素级舰船说明的卫星图像[47]. AFO[17]随后提供无人驾驶航空器图像,用于探测漂浮在露天水面上的人和其他物体。 SeaDrones See [18] 是一个大型的海洋数据集,用于不同飞行高度下的物体探测和跟踪,观测角度,以及海况. MOBDrone [19] 支持人外探测,并包含在不同高度下捕获的无人机视频,相机角度,以及照明条件. SeaPerson [20] 在海边无人机图像中支持微人探测,并包含点和边框说明. Person-in-water [9] 包含从不同高度和观看角度记录在湖泊和海洋上的无人驾驶航空器视频. IWHR [8] 专注于利用岸基摄像头和移动设备所捕获的图像在内河中进行浮底探测. 最近,SearchWing [6]提供了在最高750米高度上捕获的高海拔海洋观测的图像;然而,载有附加说明的船只的图像数量相对有限,数据集是闭源的. 总体而言,现有的超水数据集主要是为低海拔物体探测而设计的,由于两个原因不适合高海拔的OW-SAR情景. 首先,它们的目标尺度与高海拔图像中的目标不匹配:常用数据集中的目标通常跨度为20-50像素,而高空观测到的目标仅跨度为3-15像素. 其次,大多数图像代表相对平静的水条件或高目标与背面对比,因此难以代表现实世界高空观测中遇到的复杂成像条件.

blocks.en: To fill this gap, we constructed and released TinyWOD, a tiny object detection dataset specifically designed for high-altitude OW-SAR imagery. TinyWOD contains 11,359 images and 19,505 annotated instances. The dataset approximates the apparent size of a full-sized maritime SAR target (represented by a lifebuoy in this study) when viewed from a distance of 1.5 km. In TinyWOD, the annotated instances have an average ESL of 12.7 pixels, and 76.96% have an ESL below 15 pixels. Table 1 compares the main characteristics of TinyWOD with those of six representative datasets. Figure Background & Summary (a) and (b) show the differences in apparent object size and the comparison of average ESL and the ratio of bounding-box area to image area, respectively. The results indicate that the object-scale distribution of TinyWOD more closely matches the practical requirements of aerial platforms conducting high-altitude OW-SAR missions.
blocks.zh: 为了填补这一空白,我们建造并发布了TinyWOD,这是一个专门为高空OW-SAR图像设计的小型物体探测数据集. TinyWOD包含11,359个图像和19,505个注解实例. 数据集从1.5公里的距离来看,大致显示一个全尺寸的海上搜救目标(在本研究中以生命体为代表)的明显大小。 在TinyWOD中,注释例的平均ESL为12.7像素,76.96%的ESL低于15像素. 表1比较了TinyWOD与六个代表性数据集的主要特征. 图背景和摘要(a)和(b)分别显示表面物体大小的差异和平均ESL的比较以及边框区域与图像区域的比例. 结果表明,TinyWOD的物体规模分布更符合执行高空OW-SAR飞行任务的航空平台的实际要求。

blocks.en: Methods
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: Data Acquisition
blocks.zh: 数据获取

blocks.en: Considering that targets in high-altitude OW-SAR imagery occupy only a few pixels and that UAV flights at such altitudes entail substantial costs and are subject to strict airspace restrictions, we reduced the physical dimensions of lifebuoys and acquired images at shorter viewing distances to approximate the projected size of full-sized lifebuoys. To determine the appropriate target size, camera parameters, and acquisition distance before data collection, the pinhole camera model was used to relate target size to acquisition geometry. blocks.en: Based on these relationships, lifebuoy scales of 10%–100% were evaluated, with 11% selected as the closest approximation to the apparent size of a standard 72 cm lifebuoy viewed from approximately 1.5 km. Images were collected using two types of devices to capture different viewing perspectives. UAVs equipped with downward-facing cameras operated at altitudes of up to 120 m above the water surface under approved flight permits, capturing top-down views. Fixed cameras mounted on dikes 5 m above the water surface captured oblique views from the shore. Both camera setups used zoom lenses, whose focal lengths were adjusted so that most targets had a projected object size of roughly 3–15 pixels. Fig. Background & Summary c illustrates the data acquisition setup.
blocks.zh: 基于这些关系,对10-100%的寿命尺度进行了评估,从大约1.5公里的距离来看,11%的寿命尺度被选为与标准72厘米寿命尺度最接近的尺度。 利用两种设备收集图像,以获取不同的取景视角。 根据核准的飞行许可,装有俯仰照相机的无人驾驶飞行器在水面上方高度达120米,可捕捉自上而下的视野。 固定摄像机安装在水面5米以上的堤坝上,从岸边捕捉到斜视。 两台相机设置都使用了缩放镜头,其焦距被调整,使得大多数目标预计对象大小大约为3–15像素. 费格。 背景 & 摘要 c 说明了数据获取设置.

blocks.en: All data were collected from water bodies in Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province, China (Fig. Background & Summary d). The three locations provided different water colors and surface conditions. Hangzhou featured green water, with footage recorded during both daytime and nighttime. Jiaxing was characterized by yellow water and rough surface conditions, while Shaoxing had blue water. Footage from Jiaxing and Shaoxing was collected during daytime. The resulting dataset contains 2,212 images from Hangzhou, 7,007 from Jiaxing, and 2,140 from Shaoxing.
blocks.zh: 所有数据均来自中国浙江省杭州市,佳兴市,绍兴市的水体(图:背景及摘要d). 这三个地点提供了不同的水色和水面条件。 杭州以绿水为特色,白天和晚上都有录像. 佳兴的特点是黄水和表面条件粗糙,而绍兴则有蓝水. 日间收集了佳兴和绍兴的脚印. 由此产生的数据集包含来自杭州的2,212幅图像,来自佳兴的7,007幅图像,以及来自绍兴的2,140幅图像.

blocks.en: After data collection, frames were extracted from the raw videos using adaptive sampling rates set separately for each video. Each video was reviewed to assess its quality, and a sampling rate between 1 and 15 frames per second was assigned. Videos with limited object motion and background variation were sampled at lower rates to avoid duplicate frames, whereas those with greater changes in object positions or water-surface conditions were sampled at higher rates to retain distinct frames. Following adaptive sampling, the extracted frames were manually screened to remove redundant, highly similar, and low-quality images. This screening excluded 5,212 of the 16,571 extracted frames (31.45%), resulting in a final dataset of 11,359 images at a resolution of 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 .
blocks.zh: 在收集数据后,利用为每部录像分别设定的适应性取样率,从原始录像中提取了帧。 对每一段录像进行了审查,以评估其质量,并确定了每秒1至15帧的取样率。 以较低的速度对物体运动和背景变化有限的录像进行了取样,以避免重复帧,而对物体位置或水面条件变化较大的录像进行了较高的取样,以保留不同的帧。 经过适应性取样后,对提取的框架进行了人工筛选,以删除多余、高度相似和低质量的图像。 这次筛选排除了16,571个提取帧中的5,212个(31.45%),最终在1920×1080 1920\times 1080的分辨率上得出了11,359幅图像的最终数据集.

blocks.en: Annotation
blocks.zh: 注释

blocks.en: Considering that the limited pixel footprint of lifebuoys could make them difficult to annotate accurately, we adopted a two-stage annotation and review process. First, four annotators independently annotated separate subsets of the images. Second, two reviewers collectively examined all images and their annotations to identify missed instances and inaccurate bounding boxes. A total of 19,505 lifebuoy instances were annotated across 11,359 images. The annotations are provided in COCO [ 23 ] , YOLO [ 25 ] , and Pascal VOC [ 26 ] formats to support training and evaluation with the corresponding object detection frameworks without additional format conversion. Fig. Annotation illustrates the data processing pipeline.
blocks.zh: 考虑到生命体的有限像素足迹可能使其难以准确注释,我们采取了两个阶段的说明和审查程序。 首先,四个注释器独立地附加了图像的单独子集. 第二,两名审查人员集体审查了所有图像及其说明,以查明遗漏的事例和不准确的边框。 在11 359幅图像中,共有19 505幅生命图例。 说明以COCO [23],YOLO [25],和Pascal VOC [26]格式提供,以支持培训和评价,并配有相应的对象检测框架,而无需额外的格式转换. 图. 说明说明了数据处理程序。

blocks.en: Dataset Split
blocks.zh: 数据集分割

blocks.en: The dataset was partitioned into training, validation, and test sets at a ratio of 7:2:1, containing 7,828, 2,222, and 1,309 images, respectively. The split was stratified by water body, recording time, and acquisition platform to ensure that each subset contained images from different water-surface environments and observation conditions. All images extracted from the same video were assigned to a single subset to reduce the risk of temporal overlap between splits and support more reliable comparisons among detection methods.
blocks.zh: 数据集分为培训、验证和测试组,比例分别为7:1、7 828 222和1 309个图像。 按水体、记录时间和获取平台分层划分,以确保每个子集包含来自不同水面环境和观测条件的图像。 从同一视频中提取的所有图像都分配给一个子集,以减少分裂之间时间重叠的风险,并支持对检测方法进行更可靠的比较。

blocks.en: The images directory contains all images, partitioned into train, val, and test subdirectories. The annotations are stored in three parallel directories, one per format: the coco directory contains JSON annotation files in COCO format [ 23 ] , the annotations directory contains XML annotation files in VOC format [ 26 ] , and the labels directory contains TXT annotation files in YOLO format [ 25 ] . In the VOC and YOLO formats, each annotation file shares its filename stem with its corresponding image, and the training, validation, and test splits are consistent across the three formats. Internally, the COCO annotations follow the standard COCO detection schema, with images , annotations , and categories fields and each instance described by its bbox and area ; the YOLO files use normalized class x_center y_center width height lines, and the VOC files use the standard object , name , and bndbox structure.
blocks.zh: 图像目录包含所有图像,被分割成列车,val,以及测试子目录. 注释以三个平行目录存储,每个格式一个:coco目录包含COCO格式的JSON注释文件[23],注释目录包含VOC格式的XML注释文件[26],标签目录包含YOLO格式的TXT注释文件[25]. 在VOC和YOLO格式中,每个注释文件都与其对应的图像共享其文件名干,训练,验证,测试的分割在三种格式之间是一致的. 内部,COCO说明遵循标准的COCO检测方案,其中包含图像,说明,和分类字段及其bbox和区域描述的每个实例;YOLO文件使用规范的类x_center y_center宽度高度线,VOC文件使用标准对象,名称,bndbox结构.

blocks.en: File names also encode information about data acquisition. For example, “DJI_20260922162918_0001_D_000000.jpg” identifies an image captured by a UAV, as indicated by the “DJI” prefix, distinguishing it from images captured by fixed cameras. The field “0001”, following the second underscore, identifies the source video, allowing images extracted from the same video to be grouped together. The final field, “000000”, records the frame position within that video, allowing the sampled images to be ordered chronologically and supporting potential temporal analyses.
blocks.zh: 文件名称还编码了关于数据获取的信息. 例如,如“DJI”前缀所示,“DJI_20260922162918_0001_D_0000.jpg”识别了无人驾驶飞行器捕获的图像,将其与固定摄像机捕获的图像区分开来。 第二个下划线之后的“0001”字段可识别源视频,使从同一视频中提取的图像能够组合在一起。 最后的栏目“000 000”记录了该录像中的帧位置,可以按时间顺序排列所取样的图像,并支持潜在的时间分析。

blocks.en: Data Overview
blocks.zh: 数据概览

blocks.en: Of the images in TinyWOD, 93.47% contain at least one annotated object and the remaining 6.53% are negative images. Most images contain exactly one object, while 23.27% contain two or more, with a maximum of 15 objects in a single image. To characterize the spatial distribution of objects, the centers of the annotated bounding boxes were mapped onto a common 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 image plane using 20 × 20 20\times 20 -pixel grid cells (Fig. Data Overview a). The horizontal coordinates range from 2.5 to 1918.0 pixels and the vertical coordinates from 3.0 to 1078.5 pixels, with the mean object center at (975.72, 552.68) pixels lying close to the geometric center of the frame (Fig. Data Overview b,c). The object-size distribution is concentrated at small scales (Fig. Data Overview d,e,f). The average bounding-box width and height are 12.96 and 12.53 pixels, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在TinyWOD的图像中,93.47%包含至少一个注解对象,其余6.53%为负图像. 大多数图像都包含一个完全的对象,而23.27%包含两个或两个以上,一个图像中最多有15个对象. 为了描述物体的空间分布,附加说明的边框中心被映射到一个通用的1920×1080 1920\times 1080图像平面上,使用20×20 20\times 20 - 像素网格单元格(图. Data Overview a). 水平坐标介于2.5至191.8.0像素之间,垂直坐标介于3.0至1078.5像素之间,平均对象中心为(975.72,552.68)像素位于框架几何中心附近(图. Data Overview b,c). 对象大小分布集中于小尺度(图. Data Overview d,e,f). 平均边框宽度和高度分别为12.96和12.53像素.

blocks.en: Technical Validation
blocks.zh: 技术鉴定

blocks.en: Data quality was controlled through three stages of dataset construction: adaptive frame sampling and manual screening, the two-stage annotation and review process described in Methods (in which two reviewers collectively examined all images), and the video-stratified dataset split.
blocks.zh: 通过数据集构建的三个阶段控制了数据质量:适应性框架取样和人工筛选,方法描述的两阶段注释和审查过程(其中两名审查者集体检查了所有图像),以及视频分解数据集。

blocks.en: To assess the usability of TinyWOD for training and evaluating object detectors, seven representative detectors spanning one-stage [ 27 , 25 ] , two-stage [ 28 , 29 ] , and end-to-end Transformer [ 30 ] methods were benchmarked on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU (Table 2 ). All detectors were evaluated using the COCO [ 23 ] protocol, and average precision (AP), AP 50 , AP 75 , AP small , and average recall (AR) [ 31 ] were used to assess detection performance. Here AP 50 and AP 75 denote AP at intersection over union (IoU) thresholds of 0.5 and 0.75, AP small is AP restricted to objects with a bounding-box area smaller than 32 2 32^{2} pixels 2 , and AR 100 is the AR over the top-100 detections per image. The evaluation results are shown in Table 2 . Because 99.75% of TinyWOD’s instances have a bounding-box area below the 32 2 32^{2} pixels 2 threshold, AP small nearly coincides with AP and does not isolate the tiny objects at the core of this dataset. We therefore define an additional metric, AP tiny , restricted to objects whose annotated bounding box has ESL

blocks.en: For all seven detectors, precision was higher than recall, while AP 50 exceeded both AP and AP 75 . The lower AP 75 values suggest that accurate localization of tiny objects remains difficult, consistent with the sensitivity of IoU to small bounding-box localization errors [ 41 , 32 , 33 ] . AR 100 ranged from 0.351 to 0.596, indicating limited recall under the COCO [ 23 ] evaluation protocol. Among the seven detectors, OWRT-DETR [ 1 ] achieved the highest AP (0.512) and AP tiny \mathrm{AP}_{\mathrm{tiny}} (0.440), whereas H-DETR-R50 [ 37 ] achieved the highest recall (0.669) and YOLO26x [ 34 ] the highest precision (0.789). These results show that no single detector performed best across all metrics. Fig. Technical Validation shows a representative image with ground-truth annotations in the top row and detection results from the seven detectors in the subsequent rows.

blocks.en: Usage Notes
blocks.zh: 使用说明

blocks.en: Researchers should use the provided training, validation, and test splits when comparing detection methods to ensure the fairness of the evaluation. The file names allow sampled frames to be grouped by source video and ordered for sequence-based analyses. However, because the frames were sampled adaptively and manually screened, the released images should not be treated as uniformly sampled video sequences.
blocks.zh: 研究人员在比较检测方法时,应使用所提供的培训、鉴定和测试分数,以确保评价的公正性。 文件名称允许采样帧通过源视频进行分组,并命令进行基于序列的分析. 然而,由于帧经过了适应性和人工筛选,所释放的图像不应作为统一取样的视频序列对待.

blocks.en: Several limitations should be considered when using TinyWOD. The dataset contains a single object category represented by scaled-down lifebuoys. These targets were designed to approximate the projected size of full-sized lifebuoys rather than their appearance in real high-altitude imagery. The transferability of detection results to such imagery therefore remains to be evaluated. Data collection was limited to water bodies in Zhejiang Province, China, and nighttime images are less common than daytime images. These limitations should be taken into account when applying TinyWOD to other object categories, geographic regions, or low-light conditions.
blocks.zh: 在使用TinyWOD时应考虑若干限制。 数据集包含一个单一对象类别,以缩放的寿星为代表. 这些目标旨在大致估计全尺寸生命体的预计大小,而不是在真实的高空图像中出现。 因此,检测结果向这种图像的可转让性仍有待评估。 数据收集仅限于中国浙江省水体,夜间图像不如白天图像常见. 在将TinyWOD适用于其他物体类别、地理区域或低光条件下时,应考虑到这些限制。
